adjusted_prescription: To improve the agent's ability to handle complex nested queries, it is important to include demonstrations that show how to break down multi-layered questions step-by-step, preserving the context throughout the conversation. When encountering unclear or ambiguous user inputs, the agent should be proactive in asking clarifying questions to ensure accurate understanding before proceeding. Additionally, guidance should highlight how to merge information from different data sources seamlessly, then summarize the combined results clearly and coherently. Maintaining consistent recognition and reference to entities during extended interactions is also crucial so that the agent remembers key details and uses them appropriately. These strategies together will help the agent produce more integrated, context-aware, and user-friendly responses.
